name: starter.mq5
summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre indicator combined with CCI and MA crossover signals. It opens buy positions when Laguerre is zero, MA is rising, and CCI is below a negative threshold, and sell positions on the mirror conditions. Positions are closed when Laguerre reaches opposite extreme levels, with optional virtual stop-loss/take-profit functionality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre指标结合CCI和MA交叉信号进行交易。当Laguerre为零、MA上升且CCI低于负阈值时开多仓，反之开空仓。当Laguerre达到相反极端水平时平仓，并提供虚拟止损止盈功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Laguerre指标的超买超卖状态结合CCI动量确认和MA趋势方向过滤。入场条件：做多要求Laguerre值为0（极度超卖）、MA当前值大于前一根值（上升趋势确认）、CCI低于负阈值（动量向下极端）；做空为镜像条件，Laguerre值为1（极度超买）、MA下降、CCI高于正阈值。出场条件：做多仓位在Laguerre值大于0.9时平仓，做空仓位在Laguerre值小于0.1时平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数或基于自由保证金的比例风险计算，并提供亏损后递减手数的功能（DecreaseFactor）。资金管理方面，使用账户自由保证金乘以风险百分比除以1000来计算手数，同时进行了手数规范化处理以满足经纪商的最小、最大和步长要求。虚拟止损止盈功能通过在每tick检查持仓盈亏来模拟止损止盈，避免在服务器端设置实际SL/TP值。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Laguerre indicator's overbought/oversold states combined with CCI momentum confirmation and MA trend direction filtering. Entry conditions: a buy requires Laguerre at 0 (extreme oversold), MA current value above previous value (uptrend confirmation), and CCI below the negative threshold (momentum at downward extreme); sell conditions are the mirror image with Laguerre at 1 (extreme overbought), MA declining, and CCI above the positive threshold. Exit conditions: buy positions close when Laguerre exceeds 0.9, sell positions close when Laguerre drops below 0.1. Position sizing supports fixed lots or proportional risk calculation based on free margin, with a lot decrease factor after consecutive losses (DecreaseFactor). Money management calculates lots as free margin multiplied by risk percentage divided by 1000, with lot normalization to satisfy broker minimum, maximum, and step requirements. The virtual SL/TP feature simulates stop-loss and take-profit by checking position P&L on every tick rather than placing actual SL/TP orders on the server.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 固定手数，为0时使用风险比例计算
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size; 0 uses risk percentage

parameters.name: MaximumRisk
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage; used when Lots is 0

parameters.name: DecreaseFactor
parameters.description: 亏损后手数递减因子，0为禁用
parameters.description_en: Lot decrease factor after loss; 0 disables

parameters.name: VirtualSLTP
parameters.description: 是否使用虚拟止损止盈

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 检查指标的K线位置，0为当前K线，1为最近完成K线
parameters.description_en: Bar index for indicator check: 0=current bar, 1=last completed bar

pros: 三重指标过滤（Laguerre+CCI+MA）减少了虚假信号
虚拟止损止盈功能可隐藏交易意图，避免经纪商窥探策略
亏损递减手数机制有助于控制连续亏损时的风险敞口
手数规范化处理完善，考虑了经纪商的最小/最大/步长限制
pros_en: Triple indicator filtering (Laguerre+CCI+MA) reduces false signals
Virtual SL/TP hides trading intentions from brokers who might otherwise see strategy levels
Lot decrease mechanism after losses helps control risk exposure during losing streaks
Lot normalization is thorough, accounting for broker minimum/maximum/step constraints
cons: Sell开仓时错误地调用了SolveBuySL和SolveBuyTP而非SolveSellSL和SolveSellTP，这是一个严重的逻辑错误
CCI阈值默认值5极低，几乎任何市场条件下都会满足条件，使CCI过滤器形同虚设
Shift默认为0意味着在未完成的K线上交易，容易产生虚假信号和重复交易
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在极端点差或非活跃时段仍会交易
cons_en: Sell opening incorrectly calls SolveBuySL and SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL and SolveSellTP, a critical logic bug
CCI level default of 5 is extremely low, making the CCI filter virtually useless as nearly all market conditions satisfy it
Shift default of 0 means trading on an uncompleted bar, prone to false signals and repainting issues
No spread filter or trading session filter, will trade even during extreme spreads or inactive hours
improvements: 修复Sell开仓时SL/TP计算函数的严重错误，应调用SolveSellSL和SolveSellTP
将Shift默认值改为1以避免在未完成K线上交易和信号重绘问题
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤功能
提高CCILevel默认值至更合理的水平（如50-100），使CCI过滤器真正发挥作用
improvements_en: Fix the critical bug where sell opening calls SolveBuySL/SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL/SolveSellTP
Change Shift default to 1 to avoid trading on uncompleted bars and repainting issues
Add spread filter and trading session filter functionality
Raise CCILevel default to a more reasonable value (e.g., 50-100) so the CCI filter is actually effective

risk_points: Sell方向的SL/TP计算函数调用错误可能导致止损止盈设置在错误方向
Shift=0时在未完成K线上交易容易因价格波动导致信号频繁变化和重复开仓
虚拟止损止盈依赖客户端持续运行，若断开连接则无法执行止损止盈
risk_points_en: Incorrect SL/TP function calls for sell direction may place stops in the wrong direction
Trading on uncompleted bars with Shift=0 risks signal flickering and repeated entries
Virtual SL/TP depends on client-side execution; disconnection means stops won't trigger
